summary: Durable external artifact base + lockless cross-session awareness registry. Relocates z-harness plans/metrics/followups outside the gitignored working tree (five-tier fallback: Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR > XDG_STATE_HOME > HOME/.local/state > git-common-dir > pwd/z-harness) so git clean cannot destroy them. Per-run JSON records in <base>/active-plans/ let concurrent sessions discover each other's scope and receive advisory overlap warnings at implement Phase 0.
key_invariants: Lockless registry is safe ONLY because overlap is advisory — no code may make overlap a hard gate without replacing lockless delete with compare-and-delete or a registry lock.
Never invert the followup_common.py lock order — the registry takes NO global lock and cannot participate in the per-entry→global ordering.
Single-writer-per-record — each <run-id>.json is written ONLY by the process that owns that run; subagents RETURN data, orchestrator performs writes.
Base anchor enforces split-brain prevention — all processes of a repo MUST agree on base; mismatch emits base_mismatch_detected and hard-fails before any artifact write.
No mutation of the base while a run is live — migrate-plan-layout.sh refuses if active-plan-registry.py list shows any status:running record.
Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR bypasses the anchor entirely (TRUE ESCAPE HATCH); non-absolute path is a hard error.
All path construction goes through plan-path.sh helpers — inline z-harness/ literals are forbidden.

key_files.why: Registry implementation: register, heartbeat, update-scope, overlaps, list, reap, deregister subcommands. Operates on active_plans_dir(). Header carries lockless-advisory invariant verbatim.

Base resolution: z_harness_base() (five-tier fallback chain + anchor enforcement), z_harness_repo_id() (stable per-repo basename), active_plans_dir(), followups_dir(), base_dir(). Single source of truth for all path construction.
Migration script extended with live-run barrier (refuses if status:running records exist), --dry-run --all manifest mode covering plans/archive/metrics/followups, copy-verify-before-rm safety.

Haiku subagent: reads SPEC.md + PLAN.md + TASKS.md, emits JSON [{path, confidence, reason}] scope array. confidence rubric: explicit > inferred > broad > unknown. Mechanical fallback documented for offline use.
Phase 0.0 wiring: register, scope-extractor dispatch, overlaps check, graduated response per exit code, heartbeat at task boundaries, deregister on complete/aborted.
Same Phase 0 register/overlap/heartbeat/deregister as z-implement-all, scoped to single task.
register at run_start, scope-extractor after TASKS.md written (Phase 8), deregister at run end.
Human-tier concept doc: durability problem, base fallback chain, registry layout, subcommands, scope-extractor, overlap protocol, invariants, env knobs.
Incident record (2026-06-01 git clean loss), root-cause analysis, and resolution note pointing to this design.

entry_points.summary: Creates/overwrites <active>/<run-id>.json atomically via tmpfile+os.replace. Validates run_id safe basename (^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$). Idempotent. Emits plan_registered.
Updates last_heartbeat, phase, current_task, status in own record. Recreates record if reaped (benign). NON-FATAL on failure.
Merges scope array [{path, confidence, reason}] into own record. Paths normalized repo-relative. NON-FATAL on failure.

Computes path intersection of own scope vs all other live records. Exit 0: none; 10: advisory overlap; 20: blocking (only with --strict or Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP=1 AND explicit×explicit exact match). Emits scope_overlap_detected or active_plan_scan_complete.

Conservative: deletes record if (a) host=localhost AND pid dead, OR (b) now-last_heartbeat > 2x Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_STALE_SECS. Sets status:stale (no delete) for remote/unknown-host records past 1x threshold. FileNotFoundError on concurrent reap is benign.

Five-tier base resolution with anchor enforcement. Tier 1: Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR (bypass anchor). Tiers 2-4 active only when Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT=1 (default). Tier 5: pwd/z-harness. Writes/validates <git-common-dir>/.z-harness-base anchor JSON. Emits base_resolved once per process.
Stable per-repo safe basename: <repo-basename>-<8hex> where 8hex=sha256(realpath(git-common-dir))[0:8]. All worktrees of one repo produce the same id.
Returns <base>/active-plans — the registry home. Never inline z-harness/active-plans.
Returns <base>/followups — the followup-sink root. Resolves dynamically so in-flight flock fds remain stable if migration runs later.

Haiku subagent. Reads SPEC.md + PLAN.md + TASKS.md (+ task block if task_id given). Emits JSON [{path, confidence, reason}]. Confidence: explicit > inferred > broad > unknown. Mechanical **Files:** parse documented as offline fallback.

fields.run_id: string — safe basename ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$; immutable after register
fields.git_common_dir: string — absolute path to .git common dir
fields.last_heartbeat: ISO-UTC string — updated by heartbeat subcommand
fields.current_task: string | null — task ID currently executing
fields.scope: array of {path: string, confidence: string, reason: string}

base_fallback_chain.tier_1: $Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR — explicit absolute override; bypasses anchor; non-absolute is hard error
base_fallback_chain.tier_4: <git-common-dir>/z-harness — survives git clean; shared across worktrees
base_fallback_chain.tier_5: $(pwd)/z-harness — last resort; clean-vulnerable; only active tier when Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT=0
base_fallback_chain.external_default_gate: Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT=1 (default after Phase-D flip) enables tiers 2-4; =0 skips them

Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT.effect: 1 enables tiers 2-4; 0 restricts to tiers 1 and 5 only

Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR.effect: absolute override; bypasses anchor; non-absolute is hard error

Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED.effect: 0 makes register/heartbeat/update-scope/overlaps/reap/deregister silent no-ops; list and session-id still work

Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_STALE_SECS.effect: threshold for last_heartbeat staleness; reaper deletes at 2x margin for local dead pids; marks remote as stale at 1x

Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP.effect: 1 causes explicit×explicit exact path overlap to exit 20 (blocking), which /z-implement-all treats as hard halt

overlap_exit_codes.20: Blocking overlap (explicit×explicit exact match AND strict mode active)

failure_handling.register_overlaps_failure: Loud registry_error event + warning banner; interactive: AskUserQuestion (proceed-without-coordination/abort); unattended (Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK): proceed + log; Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP=1: halt. NEVER silent continue.

gotchas: Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR bypasses the anchor — two sessions with different Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR values will partition their registries silently; the anchor exists to prevent exactly this.
Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED=0 makes overlaps a silent no-op; do not use in multi-session interactive environments.

Reaper deletes only when host=localhost AND pid is dead OR 2x stale threshold; remote hosts are never deleted (marked stale only) — a remote-running session's record persists until manually reaped or the session deregisters.
scope_extractor Haiku fallback (mechanical **Files:** parse) produces only explicit confidence entries — inferred/broad entries require the Haiku model.

Overlap comparison is path-string equality only (normalized repo-relative); no glob or prefix matching. Two tasks editing the same file but named differently in scope arrays will match; tasks editing different files won't.

The anchor is written atomically only if absent — if two sessions race on a brand-new repo, one wins and the other reads the winner's anchor. This is correct; both will independently resolve the same base tier.
Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP=1 + Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED=0 is a contradictory config: strict mode has no effect when registry is disabled. No error is emitted; strict mode silently does nothing.
Heartbeat recreating a reaped record is intentional and benign; the reaped record may have been stale/dead-pid reaped while the process was temporarily unresponsive.
